We are committed to providing the highest-quality service in every state that we are in. We pride ourselves in providing quality home improvement and solar installations! Solar energy is a great way to reduce your energy bills all while helping the environment. Don’t get trapped paying high energy rates when you can be producing clean, renewable energy right from your rooftop.

We’ve been providing high-quality solar solutions to our customers for years. Our customers are our top priority, and we make it our goal to guide and help our clients throughout the entire process. We make the process simple. With years of experience, you can trust the experts at Trinium. Contact us today to see if you qualify for solar energy for your home. We save the environment while saving people money!

Check out this article on Forbes about our co-founder Drew-Michael Louviere!

About Trinium

At Trinium we pride ourselves in providing quality home improvement and solar installations! Our process starts with first estimating a prospective customer’s home to see if they qualify for solar. Many homes do not! We have a top-notch engineering team available to ensure all calculations and measurements are accurate. Once all the information is gathered, we are able to create an estimate; we then send out a consultant to explain and advise customers on the various options they have, and which are best for them!

In addition to solar, Trinium can evaluate systems such AC Units, water heaters, pool pumps, lights, insulation, attic fans, sealants, and more for possible energy reduction opportunities. Trust the experts at Trinium– we can save you money!
